description: This file contains unit test classes for Orleans grains, including implementations of FirstGrain, SecondGrain, and ThirdGrain, along with a serializer class for ThirdGrainState. It defines grain behaviors and interactions for testing purposes.

classes.name: FirstGrain
classes.description: A grain class that initiates two asynchronous calls to SecondGrain instances using different GUIDs.

classes.name: SecondGrain
classes.description: A grain class that performs multiple calls to ThirdGrain instances with different keys.

classes.name: ThirdGrainState
classes.description: A serializer class for the state of ThirdGrain, marked with GenerateSerializer attribute.

classes.name: ThirdGrain
classes.description: A grain class that manages a reentrant call counter and throws an exception if concurrent calls exceed one.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Initiates two asynchronous calls to SecondGrain with different GUIDs and waits for both to complete.

methods.name: SecondGrainMethod
methods.description: Calls ThirdGrainMethod on multiple ThirdGrain instances with specified keys.

methods.name: ThirdGrainMethod
methods.description: Increments in-flight counter, throws if more than one call is in flight, writes state, and decrements counter.
